podcast.body: Released in 1994, this album primarily featured original material, marking her return to original songs after covering standards and showtunes. It included the song "In The Sun." "After releasing an album where she covered standards and showtunes from the old days, Shenade put out Universal Mother in 1994."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
